data.title: Hoffenheim vs Bayer Leverkusen Prediction and Betting Tips | October 25th 2026
data.content:
Bayer Leverkusen hold the upper hand in the history of this fixture, having won 21 of the last 36 meetings between the two teams.
 Hoffenheim have picked up nine wins in that time, while the spoils have been shared on six occasions.
 Hoffenheim have lost four of their last five home games against Bayer Leverkusen, with a 1-0 victory on January 17 being the exception. [...] Ad

## Hoffenheim vs Bayer Leverkusen Prediction

After weeks of mediocre results, Hoffenheim have steadied their ship with two consecutive victories, and they will look to keep the ball rolling this weekend.

However, Bayer Leverkusen are currently firing on all cylinders, and given their impressive record at the PreZero Arena, we fancy Martínez’s men to come away with the desired result.

Prediction: Hoffenheim 1-2 Bayer Leverkusen
